project: Demand-Driven Medicine Expiry Management System using FEFO

forecast_evaluation_metrics.MAPE_note: MAPE excludes observations with zero normalized actual demand.
forecast_evaluation_metrics.normalization_note: Raw calendar-month actual demand is retained in the evaluation CSV. MAE, WAPE, MAPE and absolute_error use actual demand normalized to a 30-day equivalent.
forecast_evaluation_metrics.absolute_error_field_note: The CSV absolute_error field is the absolute difference between the forecast and the 30-day-normalized actual demand, rounded to two decimal places.

methodological_notes: The complete historical transaction dataset covers 24 consecutive calendar months, from November 2024 through October 2026.
The 18-month historical reference/development period runs from November 2024 through April 2026. It is not an 18-month fitted model training window.
Each forecast uses the 90 days immediately preceding its forecast origin.
Demand forecasting uses a three-period moving average based on the three most recent completed monthly demand periods.
November forecasts are generated before November snapshot-period dispensing transactions. Transactions from 1–9 November are excluded from the November forecast history.
November FEFO-eligible stock includes only active, positive-quantity batches that remain valid through the maximum 14-day prescription validity period.
The procurement review period is 30 days. Target stock is calculated using daily forecast demand multiplied by supplier lead time, review period and safety stock days.
Evaluation uses six rolling forecast origins from May through October 2026. Later origins can use actual demand observed in earlier evaluation months.
Procurement recommendations account for forecast demand, FEFO-eligible stock, incoming stock, supplier delivery lead time and safety stock.
Projected stock position is the sum of FEFO-eligible stock and incoming stock.
Recommended procurement quantity is the positive difference between target stock and projected stock position.
The November procurement snapshot assumes no outstanding incoming purchase orders.
generation_restrictions: No connection to the Django database was made.
No records were imported into Django.
All supplier and patient identifiers are synthetic.
Synthetic costs are illustrative, not market quotations.
Generated identifiers are not Django primary keys.
All CSV files require independent cleaning and validation.
